region: Example of opening Leafen from anywhere
shows: What an address of its own does

scenes.title: Only this computer, today
scenes.caption: Right now only this computer opens Leafen. A phone can’t get in.

scenes.title: Log in to Tailscale
scenes.caption: You log in with a free Tailscale account and allow it. Nothing to install.

scenes.title: An address of its own
scenes.caption: Leafen gets an internet address of its own.

scenes.title: Open from anywhere
scenes.caption: Your phone, people you work with and AI apps such as Claude open Leafen at that address.
